limitation: Utilization is sampled; graphics busy guards are reactive and permit recorded transients above80%. MPS bounds equivalent-SM execution allocation, not dedicated physical SMs or bandwidth. Task success is independently scored, not inferred from exit0.
coverage: Campaign guard ledgers harvested locally; excludes separately guarded agent tools and uninstrumented read-only audits

final_matrix.correction: Finished process count was incorrectly reported as complete evidence during progress; corrected and original failures retained

counts_note: Nonzero-exit and interrupted counts may overlap; successful means exit0 with normal process_exit, not task success.

verified_cuda_contexts.limitation: Execution allocation, not dedicated physical SMs or bandwidth partition

portable_scope: Paths to machine-local scratch logs omitted; ledger SHA256 and unit IDs identify raw evidence in per-study bundles. This aggregate is not a substitute for independent experiment audits.
